name: The Color of Blood
summary: Nikova Raskol grieves for Mac, her young grandson, killed inside Stormwind City's prison. Anger consumes her, and she sends adventurers into The Stockade to take the Defias gang's red bandanas in retribution.

sections.title: A Boy on the Prison Wall
sections.body: Mac Raskol was fourteen when he took up arms as a guard in The Stockade. Stormwind's regular soldiers had been sent to distant fronts, leaving local defense to volunteers and the city's youth. Mac watched hardened criminals and mutinous members of the Defias Brotherhood in a place far more dangerous than his experience could prepare him for.

sections.title: Tokens of Defiance
sections.body: The Defias inmates tore apart their wool prison blankets and made red bandanas from the scraps. The colors marked their loyalty to the Brotherhood, even behind prison walls. When Mac rebuked them and tried to enforce discipline, the prisoners stabbed him in the back. He died on the stone floor.

sections.title: Grief and Vengeance
sections.body: Nikova Raskol turns from official channels to cold revenge after Mac's pointless death. She sends you into The Stockade to quell the rioting prisoners and bring back ten of their cherished red bandanas. Dyed the color of her grandson's spilled blood, the tokens offer a broken family a grim sense of closure.

faq.answer: Nikova Raskol is an elderly Stormwind City resident whose fourteen-year-old grandson, Mac, was recently killed while guarding The Stockade.

faq.q: Why was a fourteen-year-old guarding dangerous prisoners?
faq.answer: Stormwind sent much of its regular military to distant fronts, so volunteers and young people filled local defenses, including guard posts in The Stockade.

faq.q: Why do the Defias prisoners wear red wool bandanas?
faq.answer: Defias prisoners made red bandanas from their wool prison blankets to mark their loyalty to the Brotherhood while behind bars.
Mac caught the prisoners tearing their wool blankets to make Defias bandanas and reprimanded them. They stabbed the fourteen-year-old guard in the back.

faq.q: What does Nikova do with the bandanas?
faq.answer: Nikova keeps the bandanas as proof of retribution. She stares at the torn wool tokens and grieves her grandson's senseless death, finding peace in knowing his killers faced justice.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
aliases: where do i get the bandanas
faq.answer: You enter The Stockade, Stormwind City's high-security prison in the canal district, where Defias prisoners are in open revolt.

angles.text: Mac Raskol's death shows the strain on Stormwind's home defense and the dire cost of sending seasoned soldiers far from the capital.
As a human, you share Stormwind's burden from Defias violence in the surrounding farmlands and within the city walls.
